title: diphyllanthus corymbosus
intro: Diphyllanthus corymbosus, commonly known as Aerial Tree or Aerial Root, is a plant species belonging to the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Diphyllanthus corymbosus include reducing pain, lowering fever, and acting as an expectorant, which helps to relieve respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
